report.description: Pipedrive provides a RESTful CRM API with both OAuth 2.0 and personal API token authentication, supporting full read/write access to deals, leads, persons, organizations, and other resources across all pricing tiers. It also offers a native Model Context Protocol (MCP) for LLM integration.

evidence.claim: API credentials (personal API key) can be obtained by users themselves via the UI
OAuth 2.0 is the primary auth flow for building apps and accessing the API
Pipedrive offers a native Model Context Protocol (MCP) for secure AI assistant integration
API access is available on every plan, providing a comprehensive REST surface
Comprehensive API documentation and stable endpoints make building integrations straightforward
